[F002] Both new tests pass (21 total, up from 19). The change is contained to `agent_surface.py` (classification logic + new sections) and the CLI help text. 

## Summary

I addressed both prior-round findings:

**[high, correctness] — `agent status` no-arg path did not classify the current agent or list known operator agents.** I reworked `agent_surface.render_status()` (`scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/agent_surface.py`) so the classification block now *always* renders: with a `<name>` it classifies that agent (`AGENT: …`, unchanged), and on the no-arg path it classifies the detected current agent (`CURRENT AGENT: …`) or reports `CURRENT AGENT: unknown` with guidance when no signal is present. Current-agent detection is a new `detect_current_agent()` helper that reads an explicit `$DONTPANIC_AGENT` override (env constant `CURRENT_AGENT_ENV`) and falls back to sniffing `CLAUDECODE`. I also added a new `KNOWN OPERATOR-ONLY AGENTS` section, backed by a `KNOWN_OPERATOR_AGENTS = ("gemini", "grok")` constant and `known_operator_only_agents()` helper that filters out anything in `AGENT_REGISTRY`, so the no-arg output now names Grok/Gemini as un-dispatchable rather than only listing executors. The CLI help text in `cli.py` was updated to match. New symbols are exported in `__all__`.

**[low, test_coverage] — no test covered the no-arg/current-agent classification path.** I added two tests in `test_f002_agent_surface_cli.py`: `test_agent_status_no_arg_classifies_current_and_lists_operators`
